my-beautiful-story.title: My Beautiful Story
my-beautiful-story.lede: My Beautiful Story is a storytelling workshop designed to deepen trust and connection.
paras: Through a series of carefully crafted prompts, participants thoughtfully explore how they came to be the person they are, with surprising relevance to their professional identities.
People regularly share more deeply and personally than they typically would in professional settings, which deepens even longstanding professional relationships.
The result is a profound shift in how people perceive one another, strengthening cohesion in ways that conventional team-building activities rarely achieve.
objectives: Develop skills to listen deeply and respond empathetically
Recognize the universal human experiences that connect us
Create psychological safety that enables authentic self-expression
Transform workplace connections from transactional to meaningful
Apply storytelling techniques that reveal personal values and motivations

authenticity-in-action.title: Authenticity in Action
authenticity-in-action.lede: The Authenticity in Action workshop explores how authenticity manifests not just as an abstract value, but as a practical choice made in everyday workplace moments.
paras: Participants will discover how seemingly small decisions—speaking a difficult truth, acknowledging a mistake, or expressing genuine appreciation—create ripple effects that transform both interpersonal connectivity and organizational culture. Through evidence-based frameworks and real-world examples, attendees will gain concrete strategies for identifying pivotal moments where authentic choices matter most.

Building on the understanding that authenticity requires both awareness and courage, this workshop bridges the gap between knowing and doing. We’ll examine the three levels of impact authentic actions create—on self, relationships, and culture—while providing practical tools for overcoming the most common barriers to authentic expression in professional settings.
Participants will leave equipped to transform their workplace interactions through small, intentional choices that align their external actions with their internal values.
objectives: Identify everyday workplace moments that present opportunities for authentic action and understand how these small choices compound over time
Apply the three-question framework to formulate responses that balance honesty with empathy and professionalism
Distinguish between genuine authenticity and unfiltered self-expression in professional contexts
Implement specific strategies for building momentum through consistent authentic choices despite organizational resistance
Evaluate the ripple effects of authentic actions and measure their impact on team trust, psychological safety, and cultural norms
